description: This PHP source file defines the HTTP_Encoder class, which handles encoding and sending gzipped or deflated HTTP content, including methods for content compression, header management, and client encoding detection.

classes.name: HTTP_Encoder
classes.description: A class for encoding HTTP content with gzip, deflate, or compress methods, managing headers, and detecting client encoding preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with content, content type, and optional encoding method.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the current content, after encoding if applied.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers to be sent with the encoded content.

methods.name: sendHeaders
methods.description: Sends the headers to the client.

methods.name: sendAll
methods.description: Sends headers and outputs the encoded content.

methods.name: getAcceptedEncoding
methods.description: Determines the best encoding method supported by the client based on the Accept-Encoding header.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Compresses the content using the specified encoding method and updates headers accordingly.
